title: [GMCP 203.023.06] Operations and evidence: Service adapters and generated MCP surfaces
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-023-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, command and native-library adapters can generate reviewable MCP tools/resources with stable names, precise schemas, pagination, auth mapping, rate limits, idempotency and redaction. Generated artifacts are reproducible, diffable and policy-scanned; unsupported semantics fail generation rather than producing unsafe generic shells. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
